main_body: market stall with canopy and counter
top_band: olive green canopy roof (rows 2-12) and brown counter top (rows 25-28)
evidence: This is a color-reduced version of the Beodeul cheese stall reference. Rows 2-12 form the 11px sloped canopy top band, followed by dark eave shadows at rows 11-14, an inset interior shelf area (rows 13-25), a counter top surface (rows 25-28), and the lower counter front face (rows 29-40).

style.evidence: The candidate is a quantized/posterized copy of the Beodeul stall reference reduced to only 4 total colors. The striped awning and textured wood panels are turned into huge flat fills (11x30 green rectangle, 12x30 brown rectangle) with 1 shading step per material.
